original.target_description: Original primary paper could not be acquired through the attempted open-access routes.

replication.target_description: Ten-country replication: final recognition accuracy for the 12 non-critical filler questions; one-way between-participants ANOVA of country.

n.location: Manuscript pp. 8–9, Participants/Table 1; p. 16, filler ANOVA
n.sample_role: Participants in the ten-country filler-item ANOVA; total is consistent with F(9, 476).
n.exclusions: Table 1: two Japanese pairs removed for failure to follow instructions and replaced; one UK pair removed for projector difficulties and not replaced. Exclusion for no exposure to co-witness details applies only to subsequent critical-item analyses.

notes: Replication title verified against supplied reference; repository lists the equivalent publication DOI 10.1016/j.jarmac.2018.09.004. Supplied replication locator p. 19 differs from this accepted manuscript: filler ANOVA is on manuscript p. 16. The country effect on filler recognition is selected from the neutral description; the separate above-chance filler tests have only all ps < .001 and no printed effect sizes. No target-specific author narrative replication verdict for the filler-country test was established; overall success language concerns critical discussed versus non-discussed questions. Original DOI landing page and Researchmap primary PDF returned 403; OpenAlex had no OA location; author-site alternatives did not expose a downloadable paper. No original statistics imported from secondary quotations.
